R.name: Realistic
R.description: You seem drawn to doing, making and working with real things. A small practical experiment could be a satisfying place to start.
R.mission: Make a phone stand from spare cardboard. Try one improvement after using it.

I.name: Investigative
I.description: You seem interested in asking why, following clues and understanding how things work. Give yourself a question worth digging into.
I.mission: Pick an everyday claim. Find two credible sources and write what you still need to know.

A.name: Artistic
A.description: You seem drawn to original ideas, expression and making things feel different. A blank page might be an invitation, not an obstacle.
A.mission: Redesign one campus poster in 20 minutes. Try a totally different mood, just for fun.

S.name: Social
S.description: You seem interested in helping people learn, feel included and find their way. Try a small moment of useful human connection.
S.mission: Teach a friend one small thing you enjoy. Ask them to teach you something back.

E.name: Enterprising
E.description: You seem drawn to starting things, sharing ideas and getting people on board. A tiny initiative is enough to test that interest.
E.mission: Record a one-minute pitch for an idea you care about. Share it with one trusted friend.

C.name: Conventional
C.description: You seem interested in clear plans, accurate details and turning a mess into something usable. Small systems can make a big difference.
C.mission: Turn one messy set of notes or shared files into a simple system someone else can use.

RI.title: The curious maker
RI.description: You seem interested in both understanding how things work and trying them with your own hands.

RA.title: The creative maker
RA.description: Your mix brings practical making together with original expression. You might enjoy an idea you can actually hold.

RS.title: The hands-on helper
RS.description: You seem drawn to practical activity with a human purpose: making something useful for someone else.

RE.title: The practical starter
RE.description: You seem interested in turning a real-world idea into action and getting others moving with you.

RC.title: The systems builder
RC.description: You seem to enjoy practical tasks with clear steps, working parts and details that line up.

IA.title: The design detective
IA.description: You seem drawn to understanding a problem and imagining a fresh way to express or solve it.

IS.title: The insightful guide
IS.description: Your curiosity about how things work meets an interest in helping people understand them.

IE.title: The curious strategist
IE.description: You seem interested in investigating possibilities, then making a case for an idea worth trying.

IC.title: The pattern finder
IC.description: You seem drawn to investigating clues and keeping track of the details. You might enjoy making a complex puzzle clearer.

AS.title: The creative connector
AS.description: You seem to enjoy expression with a human connection: stories, experiences and ideas that bring people closer.

AE.title: The idea amplifier
AE.description: You seem drawn to original ideas and the energy of putting them out into the world.

AC.title: The detail-loving designer
AC.description: You seem interested in creativity that also makes information clear, considered and easy to navigate.

SE.title: The community catalyst
SE.description: You seem drawn to people and to making things happen together. Your next experiment could start with a conversation.

SC.title: The people-first planner
SC.description: You seem interested in supporting people through thoughtful plans and dependable details.

EC.title: The project driver
EC.description: You seem drawn to taking initiative and creating a clear plan that helps a team follow through.

questions.title: Build a useful thing from spare materials.
questions.cue: Picture a phone stand or a small shelf you could actually use.

questions.title: Repair a wobbly chair or a loose handle.
questions.cue: You have basic tools and someone to show you the safe steps.

questions.title: Grow and look after a small garden.
questions.cue: Imagine planting, watering and seeing something change over time.

questions.title: Put together a small working model.
questions.cue: You get parts and a simple guide. Think about the making, not the marks.

questions.title: Set up equipment for a campus event.
questions.cue: Imagine connecting the speakers and arranging the practical setup.

questions.title: Follow clues to solve a mystery.
questions.cue: Think patterns and possible explanations, with no timer running.

questions.title: Investigate why an app keeps crashing.
questions.cue: Imagine tracing the cause. You do not need to know how yet.

questions.title: Test an idea with a small experiment.
questions.cue: Change one thing, see what happens, then ask why.

questions.title: Find a pattern in a bunch of numbers.
questions.cue: Picture looking at campus survey results and noticing something interesting.

questions.title: Research a question just because you wonder.
questions.cue: No assignment. Just a question you would enjoy finding an answer to.

questions.title: Give a college club a fresh visual style.
questions.cue: Imagine playing with a logo, colours and a poster.

questions.title: Tell a story through photos or a short film.
questions.cue: Picture turning an ordinary day into something worth watching.

questions.title: Write a scene, poem or short story.
questions.cue: Make up a little world. Spelling and polish can wait.

questions.title: Create a tune or experiment with sounds.
questions.cue: No training needed to imagine enjoying the creative process.

questions.title: Sketch a new look for a familiar space.
questions.cue: Picture changing the colours and feel of your favourite campus corner.

questions.title: Help a classmate understand something tricky.
questions.cue: Imagine finding a simpler way to explain it, without doing their work.

questions.title: Make a newcomer feel included.
questions.cue: Picture helping someone find their feet in a new group.

questions.title: Listen while a friend talks something through.
questions.cue: You do not have to solve it. Just give them your attention.

questions.title: Volunteer at a community learning session.
questions.cue: Imagine helping people practise a skill, one small step at a time.

questions.title: Guide someone through their first attempt.
questions.cue: Picture being patient while they learn something you can show them.

questions.title: Pitch an idea to a room of people.
questions.cue: Nerves are allowed. Would you enjoy getting your idea across?

questions.title: Bring a team together for a new project.
questions.cue: Imagine getting people excited enough to give it a go.

questions.title: Persuade a sponsor to support a club idea.
questions.cue: Picture explaining why your idea is worth backing.

questions.title: Try selling something you created.
questions.cue: Imagine sharing its value and finding your first interested customer.

questions.title: Lead a group toward a shared decision.
questions.cue: You listen to opinions, then help everyone move forward.

questions.title: Turn scattered plans into a clear checklist.
questions.cue: Picture everyone knowing what needs to happen next.

questions.title: Organise shared files so things are easy to find.
questions.cue: Imagine clear folders and names, instead of final-final-v7.

questions.title: Keep track of a club budget.
questions.cue: Think recording what came in, what went out and what is left.

questions.title: Check a list for missing or incorrect details.
questions.cue: Imagine catching a small mistake before it causes confusion.

questions.title: Plan a schedule with all the pieces in place.
questions.cue: Picture times, tasks and people fitting into a workable plan.
